items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)

## IMPORTANT NOTE: This competition will be hosting a Dual Round for the first and second rounds of 3x3x3 cube. Please see the [DUAL ROUND!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BurnabyCubesBigSmall2026#74887-dual-round) tab for more information.

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly later in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case, but note that we will not start the afternoon tutorial early. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition.

**Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.

items.information:
## Welcome to the Miri Seahorse STEM Cube Open 2026!
[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/MiriSeahorseSTEMCubeOpen2026)

**If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [Updates & Announcements](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiriSTEMCubeOpen2026#72483-updates-announcements) and the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MiriSTEMCubeOpen2026#72484-new-competitors) tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.**

Competitors should ***ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date***, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.

***Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
